name: zetizeti
description: zetizeti — a Socratic inquiry toolkit for design students. It won't answer; it sharpens.

scripts.retrieve-test: node -e "import('./lib/retrieval.mjs').then(async m=>{const D=(await import('better-sqlite3')).default;const db=new D(':memory:');const n=m.buildIndex(db,'./corpus/domain');console.log('indexed',n,'entries');console.log(JSON.stringify(m.retrieve(db,process.argv[1]||'I want to make the checkout faster and more frictionless',{limit:3}).map(r=>({id:r.id,snippet:r.snippet})),null,2));})"
